levels.name: Light it
levels.goal: Make the bulb copy the switch.

levels.name: Both
levels.goal: Light the bulb only when both switches are ON.

levels.name: Either
levels.goal: Light the bulb when any switch is ON.

levels.name: Flip
levels.goal: Light the bulb when the switch is OFF.

levels.name: Neither
levels.goal: Light the bulb only when both switches are OFF.

levels.name: Not both
levels.goal: Light the bulb unless both switches are ON.

levels.name: All three
levels.goal: Light the bulb only when all three switches are ON.

levels.name: Door alarm
levels.goal: Sound the alarm when it is armed and the door or the window is open.
